evidence_mode: Reuse of previously accepted native verification logs; no new solver run
S1_claim: The current-work branch recovers the exactly representable constant-density Joule solution and independently integrated energy balance over all 13 recorded verification cases.

S1_panels.a: Actual numerical and analytical peak temperature rise, all cases
S1_panels.b: Actual heat-source integral, outward heat and source-factor-weighted terminal power
S1_panels.c: Maximum recorded field error and independent flux error

S2_claim: The signed diffusion contribution is resolved for negative, zero and positive carrier gradients in the synthetic frozen-transport LQ benchmark, with analytical field and independent power checks.

S2_panels.a: Actual signed diffusion-work integral versus analytic value
S2_panels.b: Actual numerical and analytical peak temperature rise
S2_panels.c: Actual JE volume integral versus terminal power
S2_panels.d: Maximum recorded field/current/flux/diffusion-work error and quadrature error

data_integrity.zero_log_errors: Keep exact zero in tables; omit from logarithmic plot and enumerate omissions in figure statistics
data_integrity.statistics: Deterministic numerical benchmarks; no replicates, confidence intervals or inferred convergence order
data_integrity.S1_joule_off: Thermal graph uses lambda times actual terminal power; raw terminal power and lambda remain explicit in table
data_integrity.S2_boundary_heat: Individual boundary heat integrals were not logged; do not backfill them from the analytic formula

claim_limits: Synthetic polynomial verification is not a high-Pe mesh/SUPG certificate
S1 has constant mobility but Einstein diffusion remains temperature dependent and drops out at zero concentration gradient
S2 is LQ with frozen transport and is not full nonlinear ZnO validation
Local NT checks are material-point checks only
Signed JE is a simplified electrical-work model, not complete thermoelectric closure
Original A1/A2 and all historical failures remain unchanged
